policy: Give fresh task agents only the skill, ordinary task prompt and raw inputs. Keep assertions and diagnoses with the grader. No external writes or publication in bounded applications unless separately authorized. These are semantic task specifications, not automated reasoning tests.

raw output distinguishable from corrected final
prescribed method separate from use and effects
no compulsory local design or synthesis promotion
